articles.title: Trump claims he can ‘future proof’ crypto regulation with CLARITY Act
articles.snippet: The future of a digital asset market structure bill in Congress is still uncertain amid concerns over ethics provisions, with the president, whose crypto ties are under scrutiny, weighing in on social media.
